proposals.trigger: Forecast PM2.5 exceeds Very Poor band (>250 µg/m³) at Anand Vihar Hub in 6 h

actions.target: Anand Vihar ISBT & Ghazipur Freight Inflow
actions.rationale: Divert non-destined commercial trucks to Eastern Peripheral Expressway (EPE) to avoid Anand Vihar severe hotspot cluster and adjacent educational institutions.
source_refs: CAQM GRAP Stage II Directive Item 4: Regulate diesel generator sets and divert non-essential commercial vehicles from severe pollution hot spots.

actions.rationale: Extend green signal split on outflow arterials by 20% to prevent idling exhaust build-up under stagnant wind conditions.
source_refs: CPCB Comprehensive Action Plan (CAP) for Air Pollution Control in Delhi-NCR (Traffic Management Protocols).

actions.rationale: Advise schools in Anand Vihar and Patparganj to suspend outdoor physical training between 16:00 and 20:00 IST.
source_refs: CPCB National AQI Health Advisory Guide for Very Poor / Severe Category Air.

proposals.trigger: Wazirpur Industrial Area morning stagnation and high NO2 readings

actions.rationale: Restrict non-CNG commercial carrier staging in inner roads and deploy mechanized water sprinkling.
source_refs: CAQM Directions on Dust Mitigation and Road Washing in High-Density Industrial Clusters.

proposals.officer_note: Approved by Traffic DCP (North). Deployed 3 water bowsers and diverted trucks via Outer Ring Road.
